content.thinking:
There's a discrepancy in timing—the recorded flag toggle at 09:07:00 doesn't match the logs, which show the flag already on from 09:02, and even after Argus supposedly toggled it off at 09:07:26, errors persisted through 09:08-09:10, with the "already tried" note showing a later off-set at 09:10:31.

Checking further, logs still show the feature flag as on at 09:08 and 09:09, meaning the off toggle likely never propagated. No deployment occurred in the past 14 days, so the flag flip is exposing a pre-existing latent bug in spend_summary.py rather than a fresh code push. I'd put confidence around 0.8 on the flag-toggle hypothesis.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on and the account-page code path it enables (src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:35) divides by zero, so ~30% of account page requests began failing at 09:02. Errors appear in exactly the minutes the flag evaluates 'on' and the error signature is new with it.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:35
Before onset the only errors were benign: 'ClientDisconnected: the shopper closed the connection' with error rates of 0.5-2.0%

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: Same flag path, but the remediation failed because the flag-off did not actually propagate: after Argus switched it off at 09:07:26 the service kept logging 'monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations' and the ZeroDivisionError continued, and the change log then records it being switched back on at 09:10:30. The fix to try is forcing the flag off at the evaluation layer / restarting the pods so the off value is picked up.

supporting_evidence.claim: INFO io-shop: monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations (after Argus switched it off at 09:07:26)
ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:35

hypotheses.subject: src/io_shop/spend_summary.py
hypotheses.summary: Latent defective code in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py is the actual fault; the flag merely exposed it. No deployment is recorded in the 14 days before the incident, so if disabling the flag cannot be made to stick, the remedy is a code fix/rollback of spend_summary.py.
